format: C++ (with Google Test and Google Mock framework)
description: This file contains unit tests for the harvester radio traffic module. It tests functions related to radio traffic data collection, RIS reporting, configuration setters/getters, and various utility functions including system command execution and list management. The tests are written using Google Test framework and include mock dependencies for external components.
